name: Boris
description:
Boris is an Italian television series created by Luca Manzi and Carlo Mazzotta, initially produced from 2007 to 2010, with a revival season premiered in 2022.

The show brings to the stage the behind the scenes of a television set where a troupe is shooting Gli occhi del cuore 2 (The eyes of the heart 2), a satirical portrait of the many fictions airing on the Italian TV networks.

videos.title: Gli occhi di Boris
videos.overview: Ecco come si vive per tre mesi su un set pieno di doppioni, con due registi, due direttori della fotografia, due segretarie di edizione, due aiuto registi, due capoelettricisti e due delegati di produzione; ed ecco come è stata realizzata la prima serie prodotta da Fox Channels Italy, una produzione innovativa e divertente, diventata in pochi mesi un vero e proprio cult. Oltre a mostrare il backstage delle scene più divertenti o imbarazzanti, alcune sequenze inedite e le interviste ai realizzatori, Gli occhi di Boris racconta qualcosa in più: il singolare gioco di specchi tra componenti del cast e quelli della troupe e l’atmosfera un pò caotica e surreale di una meta-serie.

videos.title: My First Day
videos.overview: An aspiring director arrives on set for his first day and is faced with staffing issues, creative disagreements, and self-centered actors.

videos.title: The Count's Ring
videos.overview: Sergio forces Alessandro to sign documents that strip him of all his rights, and the excellent performance of a stage actor casts the cast in a bad light.

videos.title: The Climber of the Andes
videos.overview: One of the actors in the cast looks nothing like the photograph released by his agency and a Peruvian boy tries to sneak in among the extras.

videos.title: Quality or Death
videos.overview: To impress a director friend, René shoots the day's scenes with a steadycam, meanwhile Biascica asks Alessandro for advice on love matters.

videos.title: A+B=C
videos.overview: The network hopes to boost ratings with a new character's raunchy jokes, just when Corinna may be forced to leave the series.

videos.title: Like Lars von Trier
videos.overview: While a fan visit creates tension on the set, René directs Stanis and Corinna in an awkward nude scene.

videos.title: When a Man Feels the End
videos.overview: During some night scenes, the cast ended up getting drunk on the limoncello sent by the network director, causing several problems during filming.

videos.title: Merry Christmas
videos.overview: Alfredo replaces René, who is struggling with gastric problems, while Stanis' father takes advantage of his son's fame to get a part.

videos.title: A Matter of Principle
videos.overview: To appease the pro-Catholic press, René has to reshoot a scene featuring an abortion, while Duccio discovers that someone has taken the money from his jacket.

videos.title: The Jeweler
videos.overview: While filming is interrupted due to Corinna, Davide is worried about the low turnout of journalists at the press conference.

videos.title: Exit Strategy
videos.overview: After the first episode aired, the cast and crew eagerly awaited the ratings results, and René shot a short film about ants.

videos.title: A Special Day
videos.overview: While René is in Milan to introduce some actors to an advertising agency, the assistant director and the director of photography swap roles.

videos.title: Stanis Must Not Die
videos.overview: The series is suspended due to low ratings, so René has to remove all the cast members from the scene in the final episode and Boris is not feeling well.

videos.title: The Last Episode
videos.overview: While the budget forces the production to shoot the final episode in just two days, everyone is anxious to find out whether the series will be canceled or not.

videos.title: My Africa (Part One)
videos.overview: The crew is elated by the success of "Gli occhi del cuore." Meanwhile, the network announces that Corinna is leaving the series, and Alessandro has an accident during filming.

videos.title: My Africa (Part Two)
videos.overview: Alessandro tries to fix the problems he caused while making the show. Meanwhile, Corinna's replacement begins filming the new serie.

videos.title: Who Will Be Saved?
videos.overview: The network orders crew cuts and leaves René in charge of deciding who to fire. Meanwhile, Alessandro tries to keep the unstable Mariano under control.

videos.title: The Disguise Is Off
videos.overview: The introduction of an element of sensuality into the drama creates conflict between Arianna, René, and Karin. Meanwhile, Gloria looks for a new job, and Biascica goes to psychoanalysis.

videos.title: The Affaire Martellone
videos.overview: The writers want to eliminate a character played by an actor involved in a scandal. Meanwhile, Stanis tries to impress a new actress.

videos.title: No Logo
videos.overview: The director of photography enlists René in an attempt to insert covert advertising into an episode. Meanwhile, Karin forces Alessandro's hand in Rome.

videos.title: Death to the Count
videos.overview: Mariano, a new actor, experiences his inner dramas in a stormy way and creates problems for the production.

videos.title: The Sky Above Stanis
videos.overview: Arianna stifles her jealousy over Alessandro's new relationship. Meanwhile, Stanis waits on set for the arrival of a well-known director, and Lorenzo gets a "promotion."

videos.title: Mazinga's Daughter
videos.overview: René is forced to work on a new series whose fate is sealed. Meanwhile, discontent with Cristina grows within the group, and the crew teaches Lorenzo a lesson.

videos.title: A Tuzzo
videos.overview: Filming is complicated by the lack of chemistry between Karin and Stanis, René's worries about his career, and Duccio's attempts to sell fish on set.

videos.title: Italy That Works
videos.overview: While René is anxious about his new assignment, Mariano takes a stand with his agent and Stanis comes to a conclusion about Alessandro.

videos.title: Use Force, Ferretti
videos.overview: Cristina is increasingly skeptical about her role and that of the production. Meanwhile, Duccio replaces René, and Arianna gives in to Stanis's insistent courtship.

videos.title: The Deaf-Mute, the Senator, and the Country's Balance of Power (Part One)
videos.overview: Arianna and Stanis meet again after their night together, Alessandro plays a vacant role, and René discovers that the election results could affect filming.

videos.title: The Deaf-Mute, the Senator, and the Country's Balance of Power (Part Two)
videos.overview: Filming takes place amid uncertainty as we await the election results. Mariano takes a dramatic step, and René delivers news that surprises everyone.

videos.title: Another Television Is Possible (Part One)
videos.overview: René moves to the competition, but all that glitters is not gold. Then he receives a proposal for a revolutionary project. Surprisingly, Alessandro joins Arianna.

videos.title: Another Television Is Possible (Part Two)
videos.overview: René moves to the competition, but all that glitters is not gold. Then he receives a proposal for a revolutionary project. Surprisingly, Alessandro joins Arianna.

videos.title: Quality Is Not Enough
videos.overview: First day of filming for Medical Dimension. Lorenzo has become a cameraman, and Biascica threatens some stagehands. Alessandro and Arianna return to their roles.

videos.title: The Clip
videos.overview: The series has a new protagonist, and René wants to keep his relationship with her a secret. Sergio lends them his camera. Alessandro wants to test out his dialogue.

videos.title: The Importance of Pleasing Notaries
videos.overview: Stanis wants to co-direct Medical Dimension. Fabiana shows off her talents with the newcomer, a sociopathic actor. Lopez's arrival complicates everything.

videos.title: Coprolalia
videos.overview: Medical Dimension takes an unexpected turn. Martellone becomes a popular icon. A friend of Arianna's unnerves Alessandro. Duccio takes credit for something he doesn't deserve.

videos.title: Like Durok
videos.overview: The network tries to rejuvenate Grandpa Mauro, with aberrant results. Itala leaves the show. At the presentation of Medical Dimension, René delivers a heartfelt speech.

videos.title: Happy Grazie Day
videos.overview: The actors film scenes in a villa, under the influence of drugs and medications. Arianna threatens Alessandro. An unclear script requires a leap of imagination.

videos.title: It Smells Like a Masterpiece
videos.overview: New ideas are coming for Medical Dimension, while filming new scenes for Grandpa Mauro. Maestro Arcangeli loses a fan and complains about Valerio's stench.

videos.title: The Epiphany
videos.overview: An extra gives the crew a hard time. Financial problems lead to a makeshift solution. René has to reshoot some footage and makes a disconcerting discovery.

videos.title: Stopper
videos.overview: A great soccer player arrives on set, causing a chain of misunderstandings. Thanks to a secret meeting, René uncovers Dr. Cane's trap.

videos.title: In the Net
videos.overview: René arrives on set after a night of partying. Fabiana receives a tempting proposal, but she doesn't want to leave Medical Dimension.

videos.title: Back to the Future (Part One)
videos.overview: René forces the writers to rewrite Medical Dimension. A race against time begins to produce an original episode. Arianna and Alessandro say goodbye.

videos.title: Back to the Future (Part Two)
videos.overview: René forces the writers to rewrite Medical Dimension. A race against time begins to produce an original episode. Arianna and Alessandro say goodbye.

videos.title: The Last Shall Be First
videos.overview: More than ten years later, Boris’ crew reunites on the set of the new project, “Life of Jesus."

videos.title: Cursed Cana
videos.overview: Boris’ crew struggles to convince the "Platform" to get on board with the project.

videos.title: Fucking René Ferreedi!
videos.overview: Mariano, Cristina and Tatti Barletta arrive on the set of “Life of Jesus."

videos.title: The Set of Miracles
videos.overview: It is the day of Jesus’ miracles, yet, it is Karin who works magic.

videos.title: Jesus’ Sense of Humor
videos.overview: Zacchaeus is played by the new Martellone. But, what happened to all the extras?

videos.title: Liberté, Egalité, Grabilité
videos.overview: The set is in total chaos. Glauco gives Tatti and René a crazy idea to fix things.

videos.title: Forgive Them for They Know Not What They Do
videos.overview: René moves to second unit and, unbeknownst to anyone, the writers get back to work.

videos.title: The Eyes of the Sacred Heart of Jesus
videos.overview: It is the last day of shooting. Will René finally succeed in shooting his masterpiece?
